sentences.text:
Mr. Anchit Khokher vs Monu & Ors on 10 November, 2023
Author: Rakesh Thapliyal

Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
Sl. Date reports,
No. orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order

S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C482 No. 2149 of 2023  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. Anchit Khokher, learned counsel for the applicants.
2. Mr. Saurabh Pandey and Mr. Rakesh Negi, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. The applicants are challenging the proceedings of criminal case no. 1031 of 2022, Neeraj Devi vs.
Monu & Ors., for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504 and 506 IPC and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that there are ample possibilities of amicable settlement between the parties, since, the dispute appears to be matrimonial and, therefore, the parties may be called upon for mediation.

Apart from this, the learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicant no. 1 married to respondent no. 2 on 05.05.2011, and out of the said wed-lock two daughters were born who are aged about 6 to 10 years.
5.

It appears from the averments, as made in the petition, that there is possibility of amicable settlement, and therefore, applicants and respondent no. 2 are directed to appear before this Court on 18.12.2023 for mediation.
6.
7 Applicants shall take steps to serve respondent no. 2 by DASTI notice as well as by registered post within a period of seven working days.

In the meantime, further proceedings of criminal case no. 1031 of 2022, Neeraj Devi vs. Monu &
Ors., for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504 and 506 IPC and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar, shall remain stayed.
